answer: Proposed gate for agents serving delay beacons at an onyx mine in a karst hollow: each ID/day proves 10^8 sequential VDF steps. Validators hash a fresh unpredictable ledger beacon with the ID, verify the output proof and step count, and deny listing on failure. Assuming no cross-input shortcut, ten IDs need 10^9 steps; shared hardware and parallel chains cannot reuse work. Electricity recurs; hardware is reusable capital; no stake. Cheap power and faster chips weaken deterrence. This meters computation, not distinct owners.
